description: FlightAware runs a global flight tracking service and sells its data through two main products. Coverage: global air traffic from more than 41,000 terrestrial ADS-B receivers operated by FlightAware, extended in remote regions by Aireon's space-based ADS-B, datalink and ACARS providers and radar feeds; Firehose fuses airborne and surface positions with detailed flight status and block events (FLIFO), predictions of arrival time, taxi-out duration and arrival runway, flight hold and go-around detection and airborne weather layers; AeroAPI gives ETAs, last position, full tracks, flight status, ground speed and altitude, with historical data back to 2011 and real-time alerts for departures, arrivals, cancellations and holds. Format and access: AeroAPI is a REST API with over 60 endpoints, usage-based pricing tiers, developer documentation and an interactive test portal; Firehose is an enterprise streaming API with pricing on request and a free trial. Licence: commercial terms, not read. Caveats: the pricing tier figures were not read; the historical data page returned a not-found page. Simulation uses: flight trajectories, delays and airport surface movements for aviation network flow, airport capacity and disruption propagation models. Related records: Spire Global ADS-B data (data-spire-global-satellite-ads-b-aviation-and-weather-data), the OpenSky Network (data-opensky-network) and ADS-B Exchange (data-adsb-exchange).
